explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX), it also has a lot of other languages. so, there is no reason for you to use the word in english.
for example i will use a list of languages to describe a XXXXX:

english
sanskrit
telugu
marathi
bengali
kannada
gujarati
hindi
danish
lithuanian
slovak
portuguese

you can use any language in this list to describe a XXXXX you would like to see in a novel you are writing. however i would recommend you to refrain from using all of these languages in your descriptions, until you are comfortable with the words. if you feel any language is too difficult, or you have specific needs (such as avoiding the use of the letter “g” in the “go-go” song) you can substitute it with a few other words instead.

nowadays, most of the books i edit seem to have a section on “words” for descriptions of the characters. however, i think it is much more appropriate to put a section of the book describing the words. for example, chapter 27, “words”, may be a good place to introduce some basic words
